_what: The stop point every hypothesis carries, set before its test can run. Same block as the funnel repos' pv-tests.json and the page list's tests. Curator: the owner. Change it here only, then rerun the tests.

stop.decide: variant wins at >=95% chance AND >=20% more checkout_reached, orders per visitor not lower
stop.early_stop: after 400 per group, >=95% chance the variant is worse by 30%+

pick._what: How many recordings a teardown reads, and the floor for a page to count as a leak.
